text: Cloud Kicks wants a report to categorize accounts into small, medium, and large based on the dollar value found in the Contract Value field. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use to meet this request?
explanation: In Salesforce reporting, a Bucket Column is the most efficient tool for categorizing records without the need for creating custom fields or complex formula logic. Bucketing allows an administrator to define ranges of values for a field and assign a label to each range, such as "Small," "Medium," or "Large." This is particularly useful for grouping data into segments that do not exist natively in the data model.
hook: "categorize accounts into small, medium, large" based on a field → Bucket Column (categorize in report, no new field)

text: Universal Containers wants to ensure that cases are routed to the right people at the right time, but there is a growing support organization. The business wants to be able to move people around and adjust the work they get without having to request extra assistance or rely on the administrator teams. Which tool allows the business to control its own assignment of work?
explanation: Omni-Channel is a comprehensive service tool designed to route work items (like Cases, Leads, or custom objects) to the most available and qualified support agents in real-time. Unlike Case Assignment Rules, which are often static and require administrative intervention, Omni-Channel allows for more dynamic management through the use of Queues and Presence Statuses.
hook: "move people around and adjust the work" without admin help → Omni-Channel (business-controlled routing)

text: Cloud Kicks is concerned that not everyone on the sales team is entering key data into accounts and opportunities that they own. A Platform Administrator wants to get a better understanding of their data quality and record completeness. What should the administrator do to accomplish this?

options.text: Explore AppExchange for data quality and record completeness solutions.
Create a report for Accounts and Opportunities highlighting missing data.
Subscribe the sales reps to a monthly report for accounts and opportunities.
Configure the key fields as required fields on the page layout.

explanation: Creating reports that highlight blank or missing key fields directly assesses the existing data by showing which records lack required information. Salesforce best practices emphasize using reports and dashboards to identify missing fields and measure completeness before implementing fixes.
hook: "understand data quality and record completeness" → Report highlighting missing/blank data

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Northern Trail Outfitters has two different sales processes: one for business opportunities with four stages and one for partner opportunities with eight stages. Both processes will vary in page layouts and picklist value options. What should a Platform Administrator configure to meet these requirements?

options.text: Different page layouts that control the picklist values for the opportunity types
Separate record types and sales processes for the different types of opportunities
Validation rules that ensure that users are entering accurate sales stage information
Public groups to limit record types and sales processes for opportunities

explanation: To manage different business requirements for the Opportunity object, Salesforce utilizes a combination of Record Types and Sales Processes. A Sales Process selects which Stage picklist values are visible. Record Types allow different users to see different Page Layouts and picklist options based on the type of record.
hook: "vary in page layouts and picklist values" per process → Record Types + Sales Processes

text: Cloud Kicks has hired a new sales executive who wants to implement a document merge solution in Salesforce. How should a Platform Administrator implement this solution?

options.text: Install a package from the Partner Portal.
Create a managed package in AppExchange.
Configure the package from Salesforce Setup.

explanation: Salesforce does not provide a robust, native document merge engine. The standard practice is to download a third-party application from the AppExchange. Popular tools like Conga Composer or Nintex DocGen allow administrators to merge Salesforce record data into Word, PDF, or Excel templates.
hook: "implement a document merge solution" → Download from AppExchange (prebuilt app)

text: How should a Platform Administrator view Currencies, Fiscal Year settings, and Business Hours in Salesforce?
explanation: In Salesforce Setup, Company Settings is the central location where global organizational parameters are managed, including Company Information, Fiscal Year settings, Business Hours, and Multi-Currency management.
hook: "Currencies, Fiscal Year, Business Hours" → Company Settings

text: A VP of sales needs to report on records owned by individuals in various parts of the role hierarchy. The organization-wide default is set to Private. What should a Platform Administrator configure to achieve this?
explanation: When the Organization-Wide Default for an object is set to Private, Sharing Rules allow the admin to create exceptions based on record ownership or specific criteria to grant the necessary visibility for reporting without making the data public.
hook: "report on records across role hierarchy" with OWD Private → Sharing Rules (open up access)

text: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has created an approval process for time-off requests. Which two automated actions are available for the administrator to add as part of the approval process?
explanation: Salesforce Approval Processes support four specific types of automated actions: Field Update, Email Alert, Task, and Outbound Message. While modern tools like Flow can post to Chatter, the native approval process engine is limited to these four actions.
hook: approval process "two automated actions" → Field Update + Email Alert (not Flow/Chatter)

text: At Cloud Kicks, sales reps use discounts on the opportunity record to help win sales. When an opportunity is won, they have to manually apply the discount to the related opportunity products. What should a Platform Administrator use to deliver this requirement?
explanation: Flow Builder is the most powerful tool for automating updates to related records. A Record-Triggered Flow can fire when an Opportunity reaches Closed Won and update all related Opportunity Product records with the discount value.
hook: "automatically apply discount to opportunity products" when won → Flow Builder

text: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks is setting up a new Salesforce instance. The business requirements mandate that marketers are given access to opportunities. The administrator assigns the Marketing User profile. What should the administrator do next?

options.text: Edit the object permissions to include Opportunity.
Add a custom permission set to include Opportunity.
Edit the role to enable Sales access.
Configure the assigned apps to include Opportunity.

explanation: Profiles define Object-Level Security (CRUD permissions). The Marketing User profile typically does not include full Edit access to Opportunities. The admin should edit the profile's object permissions to include Read and Edit for Opportunities.
hook: Marketing User profile assigned, grant Opportunity → Edit object permissions to include Opportunity

text: Cloud Kicks has implemented an Employee Agent to answer benefits questions. How should a Platform Administrator prevent the agent from responding to questions about the CEO's private health plan?

options.text: Configure assignment rules to assign the agent to employee data.
Ensure the users' permissions and field-level security restrict access to the CEO's health plan.
Modify the agent's instructions and guardrails to block questions related to the CEO's health plan.
Train the agent on employee health plans instead of the CEO's health plan.

explanation: Agentforce AI agents respect the existing security model. The most effective way to prevent access to sensitive information is to leverage Field-Level Security and user permissions. The agent only considers data that the running user has permission to view.
hook: prevent agent revealing "CEO's private health plan" → user permissions + field-level security (data governance, not prompt guardrails)

text: Northern Trail Outfitters has the Case object set to private. The support manager raised a concern that reps can see all cases on their group's dashboards. What is causing reps to have inappropriate access to data on dashboards?
explanation: A dashboard's running user determines which data is displayed. If configured with a static running user who has 'View All' permissions, every viewer sees the manager's level of data, bypassing the Private OWD. A Dynamic Dashboard should be used instead.
hook: reps see all cases on "group's dashboards" despite Private → Dashboard's running user

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Cloud Kicks wants to leverage roll-up summaries on the Account object. Which standard object supports this roll-up summary natively?
explanation: A Roll-up Summary Field is natively available only on the Master side of a Master-Detail relationship. Salesforce provides a built-in Master-Detail-like relationship between Accounts and Opportunities, allowing roll-up summary fields on the Account.
hook: roll-up summary on Account natively → Opportunity (master-detail-backed standard object)

text: Which two actions should a Platform Administrator perform with Case escalation rules?
explanation: Case Escalation Rules can perform two primary automated actions: Reassign the Case to another user or queue, and Send Email Notifications to the new owner or management.
hook: Case escalation rules "two actions" → Send email notifications + Reassign the Case

text: Northern Trail Outfitters wants emails received from customers to generate cases automatically. How should a Platform Administrator ensure that the emails are sent to the correct queue?

options.text: Create an escalation rule to send cases to the correct queue.
Use a custom email service to set the owner of the case upon creation.
Utilize a flow to identify the correct queue and assign the case.
Configure Email-to-Case so emails are delivered to the correct queue.

explanation: Email-to-Case allows the administrator to configure Routing Addresses. For each routing address, the administrator can specify a default owner or queue, ensuring automatic routing.
hook: "emails generate cases" sent to correct queue → Email-to-Case configuration

text: Leadership at Cloud Kicks wants to know how long a case has sat with different teams. Which tool gives a Platform Administrator the ability to track time a case sits and provide relevant reporting?

options.text: Case Assignment Rules with Business Hours

explanation: Milestones represent required steps in a support process. Combined with Business Hours, they accurately calculate how long a case has been in a particular status or assigned to a team, providing granular SLA compliance reporting.
hook: "how long a case has sat" with reporting → Milestones with Business Hours (not just Escalation)

text: A Platform Administrator needs to export a file of closed won opportunities from the last 90 days with specific fields. What should the administrator use to export this file?
explanation: Data Loader allows for targeted, field-specific exports using SOQL queries or the built-in query builder with filters like StageName = 'Closed Won' and CloseDate = LAST_90_DAYS.
hook: "export closed won opps, specific fields" → Data Loader (export with field selection)

text: The Cloud Kicks CFO requires any opportunity over $100,000 to be automatically sent to them for sign-off. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use?
explanation: A Record-Triggered Flow can be set to run when an Opportunity meets the criteria (Amount > $100,000) and use the Submit for Approval action to launch the record into a predefined approval process automatically.
hook: "opportunity over $100K automatically sent for sign-off" → Flow Approvals

text: Universal Containers wants collaborative selling where multiple roles work together on customer accounts. Which feature should a Platform Administrator configure?

options.text: Set up default account teams with specified access levels for different team roles.
Create sharing rules to grant access to opportunities and cases for support teams.
Configure role hierarchy to automatically grant account access to the appropriate teams.
Use permission sets to provide additional access to account-related records.

explanation: Account Teams are designed specifically for collaborative selling, allowing multiple users with specific roles and varying levels of access. Default Account Teams allow users to add their entire team to an Account with a single click.
hook: "collaborative selling, multiple roles on accounts" → default Account Teams with access levels

text: A Platform Administrator wants to customize the navigation menu for users in the Salesforce mobile app. Which statement about the Mobile Only app navigation is correct?

options.text: Lightning pages and Visualforce pages automatically appear in the Mobile Only navigation menu without requiring tabs.
The Mobile Only app can be customized to show different navigation menus for different user profiles.
The first four items in the Mobile Only navigation menu appear both in the navigation menu and in the navigation bar at the bottom.
The Mobile Only app automatically includes all standard Salesforce objects in the navigation menu based on user permissions.

explanation: In the Mobile Only app, the first four items placed in the navigation list become the persistent icons that appear in the navigation bar at the bottom of the mobile screen for quick access.
hook: Mobile Only nav → first four items also show in bottom navigation bar

text: At Cloud Kicks, cases are being assigned a default Case Owner showing an unexpected Created By and Last Modified By. The company wants to change this to an integration user. What should a Platform Administrator edit?
explanation: Support Settings is where the Default Case Owner and the Automated Case User are defined. The Automated Case User is the user listed in the Case History for automated actions such as assignment rules and Email-to-Case.
hook: change default Case Owner's Created By/Modified By to integration user → Support Settings

text: A sales rep has launched a series of monthly networking events and wants to report on Campaign ROI by month and series. How should a Platform Administrator set up the Campaign to simplify reporting?

options.text: Create individual Campaigns that all have the same name.
Configure Campaign Member Statuses to record which event Members attended.
Use Campaign Hierarchy where the monthly events roll up to a parent Campaign.
Add different record types for the monthly event types.

explanation: Campaign Hierarchies link multiple campaigns together using the Parent Campaign field. The parent provides a holistic view via Hierarchy Total fields that automatically roll up metrics from all child campaigns.
hook: "report ROI by month and series" of events → Campaign Hierarchy (roll up to parent)

text: A Platform Administrator needs to create a new prompt template to summarize customer cases. What should the administrator use to display real Salesforce data in an agent response from a prompt template?
explanation: Merge Fields allow the administrator to reference specific fields from the object in context within prompt templates. When the agent runs, it replaces these placeholders with actual data from the specific record.
hook: "display real Salesforce data" in prompt template → Merge Fields

text: A Platform Administrator has set up a junior administrator as a delegated administrator. What should the administrator consider regarding delegated administrators?

options.text: Delegated administrators can unlock users but cannot reset passwords.
Delegated administrators can update field-level security on standard objects.
Delegated administrators cannot modify permission sets.
Delegated administrators cannot assign users to profiles.

explanation: Delegated administrators cannot modify permission sets. They are primarily intended to manage users within specific roles, reset passwords, and manage specific custom objects, without granting them full system access.
hook: delegated administrator consideration → cannot modify permission sets

text: Ursa Major Solar classifies accounts as Silver, Gold, or Platinum Level. New cases should go to appropriate queues based on level. What should a Platform Administrator use?
explanation: Case Assignment Rules automatically route cases to specific users or queues based on record criteria when a case is first created, ensuring high-value customers receive immediate attention from the appropriate team.
hook: route new cases to queues by account level → Assignment Rules (not Escalation)

text: How should a Platform Administrator provide users with individualized views of data on a dashboard?

options.text: Add a Dashboard Filter to change the dashboard view.
Set View Dashboard As to Me.
Set View Dashboard As to Another person.

explanation: A Dynamic Dashboard automatically filters data based on the logged-in user's sharing settings and role hierarchy, providing individualized views without maintaining multiple dashboards.
hook: "individualized views of data on a dashboard" → Dynamic Dashboard (runs as viewer)

text: A sales rep has a list of 300 accounts with contacts to load at one time. Which tool should a Platform Administrator utilize to import the records?
explanation: The Data Import Wizard is ideal for importing up to 50,000 records of standard objects like Accounts and Contacts simultaneously. It provides a browser-based interface with built-in duplicate checking.
hook: "300 accounts with contacts, one time" import → Data Import Wizard (<50k, standard objects)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Once an opportunity reaches the negotiation stage, the Amount field becomes required for sales users. Sales managers need to bypass this. How should a Platform Administrator implement this?

options.text: Make the field required for all users.
Assign the Administrator profile to the managers.
Configure a validation rule to meet the criteria.
Create a formula field to fill in the field for managers.

explanation: A Validation Rule can enforce conditional requirement logic based on both record data (the stage) and user data (the profile). The formula checks the Stage, Amount, and user profile to selectively enforce the requirement.
hook: required field but "managers need to bypass" → Validation rule with role/profile criteria

text: Which Salesforce feature allows a Platform Administrator to automate the routing of records to specific users for review and decision-making based on predefined criteria?
explanation: An Approval Process locks a record and routes a formal request to an Approver for decision-making. It includes multiple steps, entry criteria, and specific automated actions.
hook: "route records to users for review and decision" by criteria → Approval Process

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: The Cloud Kicks sales team wants two fields on Opportunity cards in Kanban view changed. Which feature should a Platform Administrator access?
explanation: The Compact Layout controls which fields are displayed in the header of a record and on the cards in the Kanban view. Editing the primary compact layout directly controls the fields on Kanban cards.
hook: change two fields on Opportunity "Kanban cards" → Compact Layout

text: Ursa Major Solar wants a guided expense report process with routing and authorizations. Which two tools should a Platform Administrator use?
explanation: Flow Builder creates the guided user interface (Screen Flow) for data collection. The Approval Process handles the routing and authorizations by sending the report to the appropriate manager for sign-off.
hook: "guided expense process with routing and authorizations" → Flow Builder + Approval Process

text: A Platform Administrator needs an automated way to delete records based on field values. Which automated solution should the administrator use?
explanation: A Schedule-Triggered Flow can be configured to run at specific intervals to find records that meet certain criteria and use the Delete Records element to remove them automatically.
hook: "automated way to delete records based on field values" → Flow Builder

text: A sales manager wants a dashboard to emphasize important data and tell a compelling data story. How should a Platform Administrator achieve this?

options.text: Assign a new Task to each rep.

explanation: Text Widgets allow administrators to add descriptive text, titles, and custom narratives directly alongside data visualizations on Lightning Dashboards, providing context and making the data more actionable.
hook: "emphasize data and tell a compelling story" on dashboard → Text Widget

text: Cloud Kicks wants a small subset of leadership users to have Modify All access like administrators. How should the administrator team accomplish this?

options.text: Assign the standard Platform User profile and edit permissions to Modify All.
Assign the standard System Administrator profile that includes Modify All access.
Assign the standard User profile and add a custom permission set with Modify All access.
Clone the standard User profile and assign a Modify All role.

explanation: The Principle of Least Privilege dictates keeping leadership on their standard profile and granting Modify All Data via a Permission Set. This provides data visibility without administrative control.
hook: small subset needs Modify All like admins → standard User profile + custom Permission Set with Modify All

text: Senior leadership wants to be notified of opportunities over $250,000 with more than 75% probability. Which feature should a Platform Administrator set up?
explanation: Big Deal Alerts are a native notification feature for the Opportunity object. They automatically send email notifications when an opportunity meets defined Amount and Probability thresholds.
hook: "notified of opportunities over $250K, >75% probability" → Big Deal Alerts

text: Sales reps at Ursa Major Solar have difficulty managing deals. The leadership team wants to help reps prioritize and close more deals. What should the administrator configure?
explanation: Einstein Opportunity Scoring uses machine learning to analyze past won and lost opportunities and assign a score from 1 to 99 to every open deal, helping reps prioritize their pipeline.
hook: "help reps prioritize and close deals" → Einstein Opportunity Scoring (not Lead Scoring)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Users are reporting different options when updating a custom picklist on Opportunity based on the kind of opportunity. Where should a Platform Administrator update the options?
explanation: Record Types determine which picklist values are available for a specific type of record. The administrator adjusts the available values within the Record Type settings.
hook: picklist options differ "based on kind of opportunity" → Record Type

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: An administrator needs to create customized pages for the Salesforce mobile app. Which two types of pages should be built using the Lightning App Builder?
explanation: Lightning App Builder supports App Pages (custom landing pages for apps) and Record Pages (customized layouts for specific objects). There is no 'User Page' type, and dashboards are created in the Dashboard Builder.
hook: custom pages for mobile app via Lightning App Builder "two types" → App page + Record page

text: A sales rep leaves and is rehired but can no longer see previously accessible records in a Private sharing model. What is the likely cause?

options.text: The stage of the opportunity records was changed to Closed Lost.
The record type of the opportunity records was changed.
The records were manually shared with the user.
Permission sets were removed when the user was deactivated.

explanation: When a user is deactivated, all their Manual Shares are automatically and permanently deleted. Even if the user is reactivated, those manual shares do not return.
hook: "rehired but can no longer see previously accessible records" → manual shares dropped on deactivation (C)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Cloud Kicks wants to change the standard Account Type field label to read 'Tier' on page layouts. How should a Platform Administrator implement this change?

options.text: Edit the Type field and change the name.
Build a custom field called Tier and delete Type.
Create a global picklist value set.

explanation: Rename Tabs and Labels in Setup allows an administrator to modify the display name of standard fields globally across the organization while preserving the underlying data and logic.
hook: "change the standard Account Type field label to read Tier" → Rename Tabs and Labels (B); can't rename standard field directly

text: A Platform Administrator is building an agent to nurture leads. How does Agentforce SDR help?

options.text: Generate a dynamic call script and talking points for human sales reps.
Autonomously negotiate pricing with the lead and close the final deal.
Analyze the performance of human sales reps and provide coaching tips.
Answer the lead's questions with responses that are grounded in company data.

explanation: Agentforce SDR interacts with potential customers by answering questions with responses grounded in company data from Knowledge bases, product catalogs, or other internal resources.
hook: "agent to nurture leads" via Agentforce SDR → answers lead questions grounded in company data (D)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Universal Containers' Platform Administrator needs to create a many-to-many relationship between two custom objects. Which two steps should the administrator take?

options.text: Create a junction with a custom object.
Create two master-detail relationships on the new object.
Create URL fields on a custom object.
Create two lookup relationships on the new object.

explanation: A many-to-many relationship requires a Junction Object—a custom object with two Master-Detail relationship fields, each pointing to one of the two objects being related.
hook: "many-to-many between two custom objects" → junction object + two master-detail relationships (A,B)

text: A screen flow needs to require a specific search engine picklist only when Lead Source is 'Search Engine'. What is the most efficient way?

options.text: Use a conditional filter in the screen element.
Use Assignment elements for each scenario.
Create a picklist and set conditional visibility so it is only shown when Lead Source is 'Search Engine'.
Configure a picklist and use a validation rule to conditionally show it.

explanation: Component Visibility in Flow Builder allows screen components to appear only when specific criteria are met, providing a clean, dynamic user experience within a single screen element.
hook: "require picklist only when Lead Source is Search Engine" in screen flow → conditional visibility on the field (C)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: The Activity Timeline is missing from the Account record page. What should a Platform Administrator do?

options.text: Add the standard Activities component to the Account Lightning record page.
Update the user's permission to allow Edit access to the Activity Timeline.
Run a report to verify whether any activities have been logged for that Account.
Add a button for the Activity Timeline in the Object Manager for the Account object.

explanation: The Activity Timeline is a standard Lightning component. If missing, the administrator should drag the Activities component onto the page in the Lightning App Builder.
hook: "Activity Timeline is missing from Account page" → add standard Activities component in Lightning App Builder (A)

text: A Platform Administrator wants to limit the kinds of reports users can create. Which tool should be used?
explanation: The Select Report Types to Hide feature allows an administrator to hide unnecessary or redundant report types, simplifying the user experience and ensuring users only see relevant templates.
hook: "limit the kinds of reports users can create" → Hide Report Types (A)

text: Agentforce is escalating cases to the support team, but the team complains they have no context. Which configuration issue is the most likely cause?

options.text: The support team members are missing the Agentforce User permission set.
The support team's case page layout is missing the agent history component.
The agent's instructions are preventing the history from being saved.
The handoff is creating a new case instead of transferring the existing session.

explanation: If reps lack context after AI handoff, the most common cause is that the Conversation History component has not been added to the Case Lightning Record Page in the Lightning App Builder.
hook: "escalated cases have no context" → case layout missing agent history component (B)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: A custom text area field should appear in the highlights panel of the Account page. How should the administrator accomplish this?

options.text: In the Account object manager, create a custom compact layout.
Make the field required and move it to the top of the page.
Create a new page layout with a section titled highlights panel.
From the page layout editor, drag the field to the highlights panel.

explanation: The Highlights Panel is controlled by the Compact Layout. To add a field to this area, the administrator must create or edit a custom compact layout in the Object Manager.
hook: "field should appear in the highlights panel" → custom compact layout (A); not page layout drag

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: A Platform Administrator wants to add prepopulated subjects for Tasks and Events separately. What should the administrator configure?

options.text: Add the new values to the predefined field values for the global actions.
Add specific picklist values for the Task subject field and for the Event subject field separately.
Create a new custom Subject picklist field on Activity and add the field values.
Include all picklist values for the Activity subject field.

explanation: Tasks and Events have separate picklist value sets for the Subject field. The admin adds values specifically to each object's Subject field to keep them distinct.
hook: "prepopulated subjects for Tasks and Events separately" → separate picklist values per Task/Event subject (B)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: A text area field was accidentally removed from a page layout. What are two methods for restoring it?

options.text: Clone the layout from a different profile and use save as.
Restore original page layout from a sandbox.
Restore from the recycle bin within 15 days.
From the fields palette, drag the field into the same position.

explanation: The field can be dragged from the Fields Palette back onto the layout (Option D), or the layout can be restored from a Sandbox by redeploying the metadata (Option B).
hook: "restore field removed from page layout" → re-drag from palette OR restore layout from sandbox (B,D)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: A Platform Administrator wants to track different types of marketing campaigns with different fields. How should the administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Create a custom report type with relevant fields.
Create a custom field on the Campaign object for the type of initiative.
Create record types and page layouts for each type of campaign.
Use campaign hierarchies to organize campaign types.

explanation: Record Types and Page Layouts allow each campaign type (Email, Trade Show, Webinar) to have its own set of relevant fields, improving data quality and user experience.
hook: "track campaign types with different fields" → record types + page layouts per type (C)

text: A prompt template gives different responses each time it's tested. Why?

options.text: Prompt Builder caches the LLM's response.
Every time the administrator runs a prompt template, it creates a unique call to the LLM.
The prompt is only sent after deployment to a live agent.
Prompt Builder runs a simulated call to save costs.

explanation: Generative AI models are inherently probabilistic. Each test execution initiates a fresh, unique call to the LLM, resulting in varying text with each iteration.
hook: "prompt template gives different responses each time" → each run is a unique LLM call (B)

text: Management wants to share dashboard components in Chatter but doesn't have this capability. How should a Platform Administrator enable this?

options.text: Select Download Chart on the component.
Set View Dashboard As to the dashboard viewer.

explanation: Enabling Feed Tracking for dashboards allows users to Follow a dashboard and use the Post to Feed functionality on individual dashboard components.
hook: "share dashboard components in Chatter" → enable dashboard feed tracking (D)

text: Sales reps miss key fields when filling out opportunities. They need to move forward but cannot enter a previous stage. Which three options should a Platform Administrator use?

options.text: Mark fields required on the page layout.
Use Flow to mark fields required.

explanation: Opportunity Path highlights Key Fields and Guidance for Success for each stage. Validation Rules enforce data entry requirements. Marking fields required on the Page Layout ensures fundamental data is always captured.
hook: "require fields, move forward, no going back a stage" → required on layout + Opportunity Path + validation rules (A,C,D)

text: What is an Agentforce use case in a sales organization?
explanation: Agentforce can engage in natural language conversations with prospects, ask relevant discovery questions, and determine if a lead meets Qualified criteria, automating Lead Qualification.
hook: "Agentforce sales use case" → Automating Lead Qualification (D)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: Cloud Kicks needs to show different picklist values for sales and marketing users. Which two options meet this requirement?

options.text: Two permission sets, one record type, one picklist
One record type, two profiles, one picklist
One page layout, two record types, one picklist
Two page layouts, one record type, two picklists

explanation: Record Types can filter available picklist values per type. Alternatively, two separate picklist fields on different page layouts can achieve the same result.
hook: "different picklist values for sales vs marketing" → 1 layout/2 record types/1 picklist OR 2 layouts/1 rt/2 picklists (C,D)

text: A flow in production is supposed to create new records but none are being created. What is causing the issue?
explanation: A flow must be Active for it to execute in production. Even if the logic is perfect, an inactive flow will remain dormant and not run for end-users.
hook: "flow creates no records in production" → the flow is inactive (A)

text: A sales manager clicks a Dashboard folder URL but gets 'We couldn't find the record.' What is the reason?

options.text: The sales manager does not have the correct permission set.
The sales manager needs the correct sales user profile.
The Dashboard folder is set to Private.
View access has not been granted to the Dashboard folder.

explanation: Access to reports and dashboards is controlled at the Folder level. The folder's sharing settings must explicitly include the sales manager for them to view its contents.
hook: "dashboard folder URL: couldn't find the record" → View access not granted to folder (D)

text: A Platform Administrator needs to configure an approval process for opportunities meeting particular conditions when closed. How should the administrator ensure the right records are included?

options.text: Use Dynamic Forms to display a button.
Add a validation rule to the opportunity.

explanation: Entry Criteria define field-level conditions that a record must meet to be eligible for the approval process, acting as the gatekeeper for the automation.
hook: "approval only for opportunities meeting conditions when closed" → Specific Entry Criteria (A)

text: A Platform Administrator has reviewed an upcoming critical update. How should the administrator proceed with activation?

options.text: Allow the critical update to auto-activate in a sandbox.
Activate the critical update in production.
Activate the critical update in a sandbox.
Allow the critical update to auto-activate.

explanation: Best practice is to activate and test critical updates in a Sandbox environment first to identify and resolve any breaking changes before they affect live business operations.
hook: "how to activate a reviewed critical update" → activate in a sandbox first (C)

text: Users assigned a custom Minimum Access profile with permission sets don't see the Lightning interface. What should the administrator do?

options.text: Enable the Enhanced Interface for User Access Policies.
Add Lightning component to a layout.
Create a page in Lightning App Builder with the org as default.
Assign a permission to enable Lightning Experience User.

explanation: The Minimum Access profile does not include the Lightning Experience User permission. A Permission Set with this checkbox must be assigned to unlock the Lightning interface.
hook: "Minimum Access profile users don't see Lightning" → grant Lightning Experience User permission (D)

text: A VP of sales gets an error saving an opportunity but the administrator cannot replicate it. How should the administrator troubleshoot?

options.text: Log in as a system administrator to troubleshoot.
Use 'Login as' to log in as the user.
Use an AppExchange product to troubleshoot.
Ask the user for their password so the admin can log in.

explanation: The 'Login as' feature allows the administrator to experience the system through the user's specific profile, role, and sharing permissions to identify context-specific issues.

text: Which feature gives a sales team the ability to prioritize deals with recent updates in List view and Kanban view?
explanation: Deal Change Highlights visually flags recent changes to Amount or Close Date with colored arrows in list views and Kanban view, helping reps prioritize deals.
hook: "prioritize deals with recent updates in List and Kanban" → Deal Change Highlights

text: In an approval process, which feature allows a user to temporarily assign their approval responsibilities to another user?
explanation: A Delegated Approver is designated to act on another user's behalf for approval requests, useful for planned absences like vacations.
hook: "temporarily assign approval responsibilities to another" → Delegated Approver

text: The sales team has difficulty understanding their stage and what the process requires. Which feature should be implemented?
explanation: The Opportunity Sales Path shows the current stage prominently and allows administrators to define Key Fields and Guidance for Success for every stage.
hook: "team struggles to understand stage and what process requires" → Opportunity Sales Path

text: Sales reps should be able to report on each other's records with OWD set to Private. What should a Platform Administrator do?

options.text: Create an owner-based sharing rule for Accounts with Read Only Opportunity Access.
Create a report and save it in a shared folder.
Use Apex sharing to share records between users.
Create manual sharing for specific records.

explanation: An Owner-based Sharing Rule shares records between members of a Public Group, granting Read Only access to Accounts and associated Opportunities.
hook: "report on each other's records, OWD Private" → owner-based sharing rule, Read Only Opportunity Access

text: Ursa Major Solar wants to see collaboration across Chatter groups, records, and CEO announcements in a single place. What should be configured?
explanation: A Chatter Stream consolidates updates from multiple sources—specific groups, individuals, and records—into a single custom feed.
hook: "collaboration across groups, records, CEO posts in one place" → Chatter Stream (not Feed/Group)

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: What are three characteristics of a master-detail relationship? (Select three)

options.text: Each object can have up to five master-detail relationships.
Permissions for the detail record are set independently of the master.
Roll-up summaries are supported in master-detail relationships.
The master object can be a standard or custom object.
The owner field on the detail records is the owner of the master record.

explanation: Master-Detail relationships support Roll-up Summaries, allow standard or custom master objects, and detail records inherit ownership from the master. Objects can have maximum two master-detail relationships.
hook: "master-detail characteristics" → roll-up summaries + master std/custom + detail owner = master owner

text: Universal Containers wants to track all stakeholders in sales opportunities with decision-making authority and influence. Which feature should be configured?
explanation: Opportunity Contact Roles allow linking multiple Contacts to an Opportunity with specific roles (Decision Maker, Influencer, Economic Buyer) and designating a Primary Contact.
hook: "track stakeholders with decision authority and influence" → Contact Roles on opportunities

text: A Platform Administrator needs to temporarily remove one dashboard from a shared folder. How should this be achieved?

options.text: Remove View access to the shared folder.
Edit the dashboard properties and move it to a private dashboards folder.
Remove the permission set to the dashboard from the users.
Create a private group and add the dashboard to it.

explanation: Moving the dashboard to a private folder (like 'My Private Dashboards') temporarily removes it from public view without affecting other dashboards in the shared folder.
hook: "temporarily remove one dashboard from shared folder" → edit properties, move to private folder

text: The VP of sales wants reps to check in with top accounts every Monday and track this on a dashboard. What should a Platform Administrator configure?

options.text: Enable the creation of recurring tasks.
Add the email action to the page layout.
Use a process email alert on the account.

explanation: Recurring tasks automatically generate the next task when the current one is completed. Because they are standard Task records, they can be tracked on dashboard components.
hook: "check in with top accounts every Monday, track on dashboard" → enable recurring tasks

text: In an approval process, what happens when a queue is selected as the approver?

options.text: The queue requires unanimous approval from all members.
Any member of the queue can approve or reject the record.
Only the queue owner is notified about the approval request.
The queue can only be used for objects without individual user approvals.

explanation: When a queue is the assigned approver, any member can claim and act on the request. The queue is treated as a single decision-making entity—one action completes the step.
hook: "queue selected as approver" → any queue member can approve or reject

text: The call center manager wants a case dashboard that can be drilled down by case origin, status, and owner. What should the administrator add?
explanation: Dashboard Filters allow users to toggle between different data subsets. Up to three filters per dashboard perfectly accommodate origin, status, and owner drill-down.
hook: "dashboard drilled down by origin, status, owner" → Dashboard Filter (not combination chart)

text: An agent needs to call an updateShippingAddress action. Which Action Instructions follow best practices?

options.text: "Use this to update shipping information. It's used for any changes to a customer's address."
"This action updates the customer's shipping address. Use when a user wants to change their address. Only use when no active order exists."
"This action allows for the changing of a shipping address to ensure it is current and accurate."
"Updates the shipping address for a customer order. The goal is to modify the address on a customer's record. Only use when the user explicitly requests to change their address."

explanation: Option D defines the Action, the Goal, and a clear Constraint, preventing the AI from accidentally triggering a data change based on a vague inquiry.
hook: "Action Instructions best practices" → scope + explicit trigger: use only when user explicitly requests change (D)

text: Agent actions are named GetCustomerInfo, GetOrderDetails, GetShippingStatus. Which naming best practice should be followed?

options.text: Remove all verbs and use only nouns.
Add 'Salesforce' to the beginning of each name.
Use a consistent naming convention by starting each with the verb 'Get'.
Use additional related verbs like Find, Retrieve, or Identify.

explanation: Consistent naming conventions (like starting all retrieval actions with 'Get') help the LLM categorize and understand the available tools, reducing ambiguity during reasoning.
hook: "Get* action naming best practice" → consistent convention starting each with verb 'Get'

text: A Platform Administrator is unable to deactivate a user who has left the company. What is preventing the deactivation?

options.text: The user is the running user of a dashboard.
The user is part of an active case assignment rule.
The user is part of an Opportunity team.
The user is part of an Account team.

explanation: Being the Running User of a Dashboard is a hard system block that prevents deactivation. The administrator must change the dashboard's running user first.
hook: "cannot deactivate departed user" → user is running user of a dashboard

text: A Platform Administrator imported records by mistake. Which two tools should be used to undo this import?
explanation: Mass Delete Records removes records by criteria. Data Loader can perform a bulk Delete operation using the Success file from the original import containing the record IDs.
hook: "undo mistaken import" → Data Loader + Mass Delete Records (not re-import)

text: What is the next step an agent performs when tasks within an agentic loop are all unsatisfactory?

options.text: Provides the best answer possible with caveats

explanation: When results are unsatisfactory, the agent asks for additional information to clarify intent or request missing data, initiating a new loop with better inputs.
hook: "agentic loop, all tasks unsatisfactory" → ask for additional information (not error/route to human)

text: The sales and service teams need quick dashboards but the administrator doesn't know where to start. What should the administrator do?

options.text: Use Salesforce Labs Field Service Dashboards from AppExchange.
Enable Einstein Analytics and build custom dashboards.
Use the Salesforce Labs CRM Dashboards for sales teams from AppExchange.
Manually create dashboards without prebuilt templates.

explanation: Salesforce Labs CRM Dashboards packages are free, pre-configured, and can be installed in minutes. They provide an excellent baseline for sales pipeline and case management.
hook: "quick dashboards, doesn't know where to start" → Salesforce Labs CRM Dashboards from AppExchange

text: Cloud Kicks wants Agentforce to adapt its behavior based on real-time customer input. Which feature enables this?
explanation: Custom Actions allow an agent to take specific, real-time steps based on customer input. Powered by Flows, Apex, or Prompt Templates, they enable autonomous Salesforce interaction.
hook: "adapt behavior based on real-time customer input" → Custom actions (not Data Cloud/flow)

text: Which action should be configured to reverse a submitted approval request and unlock the associated record?
explanation: Recall Actions allow the submitter or administrator to pull a record back out of the approval queue. Common recall actions include a Field Update to 'Draft' and unlocking the record.
hook: "reverse submitted approval and unlock record" → Recall Actions

text: Which component of an approval process defines the chain of approval, determines which records advance, and specifies where to assign requests?
explanation: Approval Steps define the chain of approval with their own criteria to determine if a record enters that step, and they specify the Assigned Approver for complex routing.
hook: "defines chain of approval, which records advance, where to assign" → Approval Steps

category: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
text: A Platform Administrator wants to change a master-detail relationship to a lookup. Which scenario prevents this?

options.text: A junction object is required to support the lookup.
Roll-up summary fields exist on the master object.
The lookup field in all records contains a value.
The lookup field is required for saving records.

explanation: Roll-up summary fields depend on a master-detail relationship. Salesforce prevents the conversion until those roll-up summary fields are deleted.
hook: "cannot convert master-detail to lookup" → roll-up summary fields exist on master

text: All cases submitted with Case Reason of Installation must be acknowledged via email and assigned to appropriate agents. Cases still in New status after 4 hours must be escalated. Auto-response rules are implemented. Which additional tool is necessary?
explanation: Auto-response rules handle the immediate acknowledgment. Escalation Rules handle the time-based requirement of monitoring cases and escalating them after 4 hours in New status.
hook: "cases New >4 hrs must escalate; auto-response already set" → add Escalation Rules
